en.s: The Battle of Canhe Slope, alternatively the Battle of Canhebei (Chinese: 參合陂之戰), was a battle in the history of China in 395 where the Xianbei-led Later Yan dynasty, then ruling over northern and central China, had launched a punitive campaign against its former vassal, the Northern Wei dynasty, also of Xianbei extraction.

en.s: The Song conquest of the Later Shu was a war between the Northern Song dynasty and its southwestern neighbor, the Later Shu dynasty from 964 to 965. Despite natural barriers, the Later Shu defense proved extremely incompetent, and the Later Shu emperor Meng Chang surrendered within 70 days of the Northern Song invasion.

zh.s: 阿什梅尼战役又称阿什梅纳战役（立陶宛语：Ašmenos mūšis），于1432年12月8日在阿什梅尼爆发。交战双方分别是斯维特里盖拉和齐吉曼塔斯·凯斯图泰提斯率领的军队，两人都争夺立陶宛大公国的王位。这场战役发生于1432年至1438年的立陶宛内战期间。

en.t: Ahmad ibn Abi Jum'ah wrote his Oran fatwa, arguing for the relaxation of Islamic law for forcibly converted Muslims in Spain
en.s: The Oran fatwa was a responsum fatwa, or an Islamic legal opinion, issued in 1502 to address the crisis that occurred when Muslims in the Crown of Castile, in present-day Spain, were forced to convert to Christianity in 1500–1502. It was authored by a maliki mufti Ahmad ibn Abi Jum'ah, an Algerian scholar of Islamic law of the Maliki school; the term "Oran fatwa" was applied by modern scholars, due to the word "Al-Wahrani" ("of Oran") that appears in the text as part of the author's name.

zh.t: 艾哈迈德·本·阿比·朱姆阿撰写《奥兰教令》
zh.s: 《奥兰教令》是1502年发布的一份伊斯兰教法意见，回应了卡斯蒂利亚王国穆斯林在1500至1502年被迫改信基督教所引发的困境。作者艾哈迈德·本·阿比·朱姆阿是阿尔及利亚的马立克派法学家；现代学者根据其名字中的“奥兰人”（Al-Wahrani）一词，称这份教令为《奥兰教令》。

en.s: The Battle of Bloody Creek was fought December 8, 1757, during the French and Indian War. An Acadian and Mi'kmaq militia defeated a detachment of British soldiers at Bloody Creek (formerly René Forêt River), which empties into the Annapolis River at present day Carleton Corner, Nova Scotia. The battle occurred at the same site as a battle in 1711 during Queen Anne's War.

zh.s: 血溪战役于1757年12月8日爆发，属于法印战争的一部分。阿卡迪亚人与米克马克人组成的民兵在血溪击败一支英国士兵分队。血溪旧称勒内·福雷河，汇入新斯科舍省卡尔顿科纳现址附近的安纳波利斯河。这场战斗发生在1711年安妮女王战争一场战斗的同一地点。

en.s: The 1802 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on December 8, 1802, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Democratic-Republican candidate and member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from Clarendon District James Burchill Richardson defeated fellow Democratic-Republican candidate and incumbent Lieutenant Governor of South Carolina Richard Winn, as well as Federalist candidate, former Governor of South Carolina and 1796 presidential election Vice Presidential nominee Thomas Pinckney and Democratic-Republican candidate John Gaillard, after receiving a majority of votes in a General Assembly secret ballot vote.

en.s: The Battle of Sauce of 1816 took place between the Luso-Brazilian forces under the command of Pinto de Araújo Correia in Arroyo Oriental, modern-day Uruguay. The orientals, led by Artiguist commander Pedro Gutierrez, attack by surprise and caused the Luso-Brazilian army to retreat, leaving 150 soldiers dead on the battlefield.

zh.s: 1816年索斯战役发生在葡萄牙—巴西军队与东岸军队之间，地点位于如今乌拉圭境内的东方河省。葡萄牙—巴西军由平托·德·阿劳若·科雷亚指挥，此前刚击败弗鲁克图奥索·里维拉的部队。佩德罗·古铁雷斯率领的阿蒂加斯派东岸军队发动突袭，迫使葡萄牙—巴西军撤退，战场上留下150名阵亡士兵。

en.s: The 1834 Boston mayoral election saw the election of incumbent Theodore Lyman II. It was held on December 8, 1834. Incumbent mayor Lyman was a Democrat. The decision for the Whigs not to put forth their own candidate came despite their dominance in the city's other municipal races in coinciding election.

Mexican militia forces attempted to destroy the United States Army garrison, occupying the peninsular town. en.s: The Battle of Loncomilla was the decisive battle of the 1851 Chilean Revolution between conservative government and liberal rebel forces on 8 December 1851. The conservative victory in the battle essentially crushed the revolution. The rebel army of José María de la Cruz's was aided by Mapuche chief Mañil who participated in battle with his warriors. After defeat at Loncomilla Mañil returned south.

zh.s: 隆科米利亚战役是1851年智利革命中的决定性战役，于1851年12月8日在保守派政府军与自由派叛军之间爆发。保守派获胜，革命基本被镇压。何塞·玛丽亚·德·拉克鲁斯的叛军得到马普切族首领马尼尔及其战士的援助。隆科米利亚战败后，马尼尔率部返回南方。

en.s: The 1851 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on December 8, 1851 to elect the governor of Virginia. It was the first gubernatorial election in Virginia in which the governor was elected by direct popular vote, instead of being selected by the state legislature. The change was brought about by the adoption of the Virginia Constitution of 1851.

zh.s: 1851年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于1851年12月8日举行。这是该州首次由选民直接投票选出州长；此前州长由州议会选出。这一变化源于弗吉尼亚州于1851年通过的新州宪法。

en.s: An apostolic constitution (Latin: constitutio apostolica) is the most solemn form of legislation issued by the Pope. It is one of several types of papal bull that can be issued from the Vatican. This high-level document normally deals with matters related to the governance and structure of the Church such as confirming laws, regulations, or institutions within the Church.
en.n: In his Apostolic constitution Ineffabilis Deus, Pope Pius IX proclaims the dogmatic definition of Immaculate Conception, which holds that the Blessed Virgin Mary was conceived free of Original Sin.

zh.s: 宗座宪章（拉丁语：constitutio apostolica）是教宗颁布的最高规格立法文件，是梵蒂冈可以颁布的多种教宗诏书之一。这类高级别文件通常涉及教会治理和组织架构，例如确认教会内部的法律、规章或机构。
zh.n: 教宗庇护九世在宗座宪章《不可言喻的天主》中，正式确立了圣母无染原罪的教义：圣母玛利亚受孕时未受原罪玷污。

en.s: The Iglesia de la Compañía de Jesús Fire (8 December 1863) was a mass casualty event in Santiago, Chile. It is the deadliest fire known to have occurred in the city, one of the deadliest single-building fires in world history and one of the deadliest-ever fires within a religious site. Between 2,000 and 3,000 people died, most of whom were women.

zh.s: 耶稣会教堂大火发生于1863年12月8日，地点在智利圣地亚哥。这是已知圣地亚哥最严重的火灾之一，也是世界上最严重的单体建筑火灾之一，并列宗教场所历史上最致命的火灾之一。遇难人数在2,000至3,000人之间，其中大多数是女性。

en.t: Establishment of American Federation of Labor
en.s: The American Federation of Labor (A.F. of L.) was a national federation of labor unions in the United States that continues today as the AFL-CIO. It was founded in Columbus, Ohio, in 1886 by an alliance of craft unions eager to provide mutual support and disappointed in the Knights of Labor. Samuel Gompers was elected the full-time president at its founding convention and was re-elected every year except one until his death in 1924.

zh.s: 美国劳工联盟（AFL）是美国全国性的工会联合组织，后来发展为现今的美国劳工联合会—产业工会联合会（AFL-CIO）。它于1886年在俄亥俄州哥伦布市成立，由一批希望相互支持、对劳工骑士团感到失望的行业工会组成。塞缪尔·冈珀斯在成立大会上当选专职主席；除一年外，他每年都再次当选，直至1924年去世。

en.t: King Gustaf V of Sweden accedes to the Swedish throne
en.s: Gustaf V (Oscar Gustaf Adolf; 16 June 1858 – 29 October 1950) was King of Sweden from 8 December 1907 until his death in 1950. He was the eldest son of King Oscar II and Sophia of Nassau, a half-sister of Adolphe, Grand Duke of Luxembourg. zh.s: 古斯塔夫五世（奥斯卡·古斯塔夫·阿道夫，1858年6月16日—1950年10月29日）于1907年12月8日继承瑞典王位，在位至1950年去世。他是奥斯卡二世与拿骚的索菲亚之长子；索菲亚是卢森堡大公阿道夫的同父异母姐姐。古斯塔夫五世在位近43年，是瑞典在位年龄最大的君主，享年92岁。

en.t: German Imperial War Council of 8 December 1912
en.s: The German Imperial War Council of 8 December 1912 was an informal conference of some of the highest military leaders of the German Empire. Meeting at the Stadtschloss in Berlin, they discussed and debated the tense military and diplomatic situation in Europe at the time. As a result of the Russian Great Military Program announced in November, Austria-Hungary's concerns about Serbian successes in the First Balkan War, and certain British communications, the possibility of war was a prime topic of the meeting.

zh.s: 1912年12月8日的德国帝国战争会议是德国帝国数名最高级军事领导人参加的一场非正式会议。会议在柏林王宫举行，讨论欧洲当时紧张的军事与外交局势。俄国于11月公布大规模军事计划、奥匈帝国担忧塞尔维亚在第一次巴尔干战争中获胜，以及英国方面的一些沟通，都使战争可能性成为会议重点议题。

en.s: The 1912 Copa de Honor Cousenier was the final match to decide the winner of the Copa de Honor Cousenier, the 8th. edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Uruguayan side River Plate and Argentine Racing Club de Avellaneda. The match was held in the Estadio Gran Parque Central in Montevideo, on December 8, 1912.

zh.s: 1912年荣誉杯决赛决出了第8届荣誉杯的冠军。这项国际赛事由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同举办。决赛于1912年12月8日在蒙得维的亚的格兰帕尔克中央球场举行，由乌拉圭河床队对阵阿根廷竞技队。

en.s: The 1913 Calgary municipal election took place on December 8, 1913 to elect a Mayor and twelve Aldermen to sit on the twenty-ninth Calgary City Council from January 2, 1914 to January 2, 1915. Additionally a Commissioner, two trustees for the Public School Board, three trustees for the Separate School Board, two bylaws regarding the term and remuneration of Aldermen and a plebislicte on whether to donate the Mewata Park to the Dominion Government for the site of the Mewata Armouries was included on the ballot.

zh.s: 卡尔加里于1913年12月8日举行市政选举，选出市长和12名市议员，组成第29届卡尔加里市议会，任期为1914年1月2日至1915年1月2日。选票还包括选出一名专员、公立学校董事会的两名董事、独立学校董事会的三名董事，对两项有关市议员任期和薪酬的市政条例进行表决，以及公投是否将梅瓦塔公园捐给联邦政府，用作梅瓦塔军械库的选址。

en.s: The Battle of Esc-Scèbb, also known as the Battle of the Esc-Scèbb wells, was fought on 8 December 1913 in the fields north of Esc-Scebb, between the departments of the Regio Esercito, commanded by lieutenant Antonio Giuseppe Miani and the Libyan guerrillas of Mohammed ben Abdallah. The battle can be classified as part of the First phase of the Italian colonization of Libya.

zh.s: 埃斯克-斯切布战役又称埃斯克-斯切布水井战役，于1913年12月8日在埃斯克-斯切布以北的田野中爆发。交战双方是意大利皇家陆军分队和利比亚游击队；意军由安东尼奥·朱塞佩·米亚尼中尉指挥，利比亚方面由穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉率领。这场战斗属于意大利殖民利比亚的第一阶段。

loc: 福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）

en.s: The Battle of the Falkland Islands was a British naval victory over the Imperial German Navy on 8 December 1914 during the First World War in the South Atlantic. The British, after a defeat at the Battle of Coronel on 1 November, sent a large force to track down and destroy the victorious German cruiser squadron. Admiral Graf Maximilian von Spee—commanding the German squadron of two armoured cruisers, SMS Scharnhorst and Gneisenau, the light cruisers SMS Nürnberg (1906), Dresden and Leipzig, and three auxiliaries—attempted to raid the British supply base at Stanley in the Falkland Islands.

zh.s: 福克兰群岛海战是第一次世界大战期间英国海军对德意志帝国海军的一场胜利，发生于1914年12月8日，地点在南大西洋。英国在11月1日的科罗内尔海战中战败后，派出大批舰艇追踪并摧毁获胜的德国巡洋舰分舰队。马克西米利安·冯·施佩伯爵海军上将率领这支德军舰队，包括两艘装甲巡洋舰“沙恩霍斯特”号和“格奈森瑙”号、轻巡洋舰“纽伦堡”号（1906年）、“德累斯顿”号和“莱比锡”号，以及三艘辅助舰。他试图袭击福克兰群岛斯坦利港的英国补给基地。

en.s: The December 1917 coup d'état (Portuguese: Golpe de Estado de Dezembro de 1917) was a politico-military uprising led by Sidónio Pais, which started in Lisbon, Portugal, with the objective of taking power from the Democratic Party, which had won every election in Portugal since the foundation of the Portuguese First Republic in October 1910.

zh.s: 1917年12月政变（葡萄牙语：Golpe de Estado de Dezembro de 1917）是西多尼奥·派斯领导的一场政治军事起义，始于葡萄牙里斯本。起义旨在推翻民主党；自1910年10月葡萄牙第一共和国成立以来，民主党赢得了每次选举。

en.s: The Khopyor–Don Operation (November 20 – December 8, 1919) was an offensive during the Russian Civil War of the 9th Army of the Southeastern Front of the Red Army, reinforced by the Cavalry Corps of the 10th Army, against the forces of the Don Army, in order to ensure the stability of the left wing of the Southern Front of the Red Army and reach the Don River.

zh.s: 霍皮奥尔—顿河行动于1919年11月20日至12月8日进行，是俄国内战期间的一次攻势。红军东南方面军第9集团军在第10集团军骑兵军增援下，对顿河军发动进攻，目的是稳住红军南方面军左翼并推进至顿河。

en.t: The Irish Free State executes four anti-Treaty IRA leaders
en.s: On December 8, 1922, the Irish Free State executed four imprisoned anti-Treaty IRA leaders: Liam Mellows, Rory O’Connor, Joe McKelvey and Dick Barrett.

zh.t: 爱尔兰自由邦处决4名反条约派共和军领导人
zh.s: 1922年12月8日，爱尔兰自由邦处决了4名被关押的反《英爱条约》共和军领导人：利亚姆·梅洛斯、罗里·奥康纳、乔·麦凯尔维和迪克·巴雷特。

en.s: The 1930 Sanitary Board Election was supposed to be held on 8 December 1930 for the one of the 2 unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Only ratepayers who were included in the Special and Common Jury Lists of the years or ratepayers who are exempted from serving on Juries on account of their professional avocations, unofficial members of the Executive or Legislative Council, or categories of profession were entitled to vote at the election. Dr. Roberto Alexandre de Castro Basto was elected without being contested, replacing the other Portuguese board member José Pedro Braga.

zh.s: 1930年洁净局选举原定于1930年12月8日举行，选出香港洁净局两个非官守席位中的一个。只有列入当年特别陪审员和普通陪审员名单的纳税人、因职业原因获豁免担任陪审员的纳税人、行政局或立法局非官守议员，以及特定职业类别的人士，才有投票资格。葡萄牙籍的罗伯托·亚历山大·德·卡斯特罗·巴斯托医生在没有对手的情况下当选，接替另一位葡萄牙籍洁净局成员若泽·佩德罗·布拉加。

en.s: The anarchist insurrection of December 1933 was an attempted revolution by Spanish anarchists, in response to the victory of the right-wing in the 1933 Spanish general election. It was the third of a series of anarchist insurrections in Spain, following those in January 1932 and January 1933. The insurrection was centred in Aragon and La Rioja, where revolutionaries took over the regional capitals and a number of small towns, proclaiming libertarian communism and destroying municipal documents.

zh.s: 1933年12月，无政府主义者为回应西班牙1933年大选中右翼获胜，发动了一场未遂革命。这是西班牙一系列无政府主义起义中的第三次，前两次分别发生于1932年1月和1933年1月。起义主要集中在阿拉贡和拉里奥哈，起义者控制了当地首府和若干小镇，宣布建立自由共产主义，并销毁市政档案。

en.s: The 1935 Tschammerpokal final decided the winner of the 1935 Tschammerpokal, the first season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 8 December 1935 at the Rheinstadion in Düsseldorf. 1. FC Nürnberg won the match 2–0 against Schalke 04 to claim the first national cup title.

zh.s: 1935年Tschammerpokal决赛决出了德国淘汰制足球杯赛首届赛事的冠军。决赛于1935年12月8日在杜塞尔多夫的莱茵体育场举行，纽伦堡足球俱乐部以2比0击败沙尔克04，夺得首个全国杯赛冠军。

en.t: Independiente and San Lorenzo draw in the first Copa Adrián Escobar final
en.s: On December 8, 1939, Independiente and San Lorenzo played the final of the first Copa Adrián Escobar at River Plate’s stadium in Buenos Aires. The match ended 0–0, with the teams also tied 1–1 on corner kicks, so a replay was needed to decide the cup.
en.n: This records the drawn final on December 8, 1939. The replay was played on August 15, 1940, rather than later on the same day.

zh.t: 首届埃斯科巴杯决赛独立队与圣洛伦索战平
zh.s: 1939年12月8日，独立队与圣洛伦索在布宜诺斯艾利斯的河床队主场进行首届埃斯科巴杯决赛。双方0比0战平，角球数也同为1个，需要通过重赛决定冠军。
zh.n: 此条记录1939年12月8日战平的决赛。重赛在1940年8月15日举行，并非同一天。

en.t: South-East Asian theatre of World War II
en.s: The South-East Asian Theatre of World War II was the name given to the campaigns of the Pacific War in Burma, Ceylon, India, Thailand, Indochina, Malaya and Singapore. Objectives for conquering these countries included the seizure of natural resources such as rubber and petroleum from European colonies in the region. Conflict in this theatre began when the Empire of Japan invaded French Indochina in September 1940 and rose to a new level following the Raid on Pearl Harbor, and simultaneous attacks on Hong Kong, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Malaya on 7/8 December 1941.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战东南亚战区
zh.s: 第二次世界大战东南亚战区是太平洋战争期间在缅甸、锡兰、印度、泰国、印度支那、马来亚和新加坡展开的战事统称。日本试图征服这些地区，目的之一是从当地欧洲殖民地夺取橡胶和石油等自然资源。该战区的冲突始于1940年9月日本入侵法属印度支那；1941年12月7日至8日，日本突袭珍珠港，并同时进攻香港、菲律宾、泰国、新加坡和马来亚，战事随之升级。

en.s: The bombing of Singapore was an attack on 8 December 1941 by seventeen G3M Nell bombers of Mihoro Air Group (Mihoro Kaigun Kōkūtai), Imperial Japanese Navy, flying from Thu Dau Mot in southern Indochina. The attack began at around 0430, shortly after Japanese forces landed on Kota Bharu, Malaya. It was the first knowledge the Singapore population had that war had broken out in the Far East.

zh.s: 1941年12月8日，17架日本海军美幌航空队的G3M“九六式陆上攻击机”从法属印度支那南部土油木起飞，轰炸新加坡。袭击约于凌晨4时30分开始，当时日军刚在马来亚哥打巴鲁登陆。这是新加坡居民首次得知远东已经开战。

en.s: The Japanese invasion of Thailand occurred on 8 December 1941. It was fought between Thailand and the Empire of Japan. Despite fierce fighting in southern Thailand, the resistance lasted only a matter of hours before ending in a ceasefire.

zh.s: 日本于1941年12月8日入侵泰国。交战双方为泰国和日本帝国。泰国南部发生激烈战斗，但抵抗只持续了数小时，随后双方停火。

en.t: United States declaration of war on Japan
en.s: On December 8, 1941, at 12:30 PM ET, the 77th United States Congress declared war (Pub. L. 77–328, 55 Stat. 795) on the Empire of Japan in response to its surprise attack on Pearl Harbor and subsequent declaration of war the prior day.

zh.s: 1941年12月8日下午12时30分（美国东部时间），美国第77届国会通过公法77-328号（《美国法令汇编》第55卷第795页），向日本帝国宣战，以回应日本突然袭击珍珠港，以及日本在前一天对美国宣战。

en.s: The Battle of Hong Kong (8–25 December 1941), also known as the Defence of Hong Kong and the Fall of Hong Kong, was one of the first battles of the Pacific War in World War II. On the same morning as the attack on Pearl Harbor, forces of the Empire of Japan attacked the British Crown colony of Hong Kong around the same time that Japan declared war on Britain.

zh.s: 香港战役（1941年12月8日至25日）又称香港保卫战或香港沦陷，是第二次世界大战太平洋战争初期的战役之一。珍珠港遇袭当天上午，日本帝国军队进攻英国殖民地香港，时间与日本对英国宣战大致相同。

en.s: The Malayan campaign, referred to by Japanese sources as the Malay Operation (馬来作戦, Maree Sakusen), was a military campaign fought by Allied and Axis forces in Malaya from 8 December 1941 – 15 February 1942 at the opening of the Pacific War and during the Second World War. It was dominated by land battles between British Commonwealth army units and the Imperial Japanese Army, with minor skirmishes at the beginning of the campaign between British Commonwealth and Royal Thai Police.

zh.s: 马来亚战役在日本资料中称为“马来作战”（馬来作戦，Maree Sakusen），是第二次世界大战太平洋战争初期同盟国与轴心国在马来亚进行的一场军事行动，持续时间为1941年12月8日至1942年2月15日。战事以英联邦部队和日本帝国陆军之间的陆战为主；战役初期还发生过少量英联邦部队与泰国皇家警察之间的冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Kota Bharu began just after midnight on 8 December 1941 (local time) before the attack on Pearl Harbor. It was the first major battle of the Pacific War, and was fought between ground forces of the British Indian Army and the Empire of Japan. Kota Bharu, the capital of Kelantan State on Malaysia's northeast coast, was, in 1941, the Royal Air Force's (RAF) and Royal Australian Air Force's (RAAF) base of operations in Northern Malaya.

zh.s: 哥打巴鲁战役于当地时间1941年12月8日午夜刚过爆发，时间早于珍珠港遇袭。这是太平洋战争的第一场主要战役，交战双方是英属印度陆军地面部队和日本帝国。哥打巴鲁是马来西亚东北海岸吉兰丹州首府；1941年，这里是英国皇家空军和澳大利亚皇家空军在马来亚北部的行动基地。

en.s: The attack on Clark Field (Filipino: Paglusob sa Kampo ng Clark; Kapampangan: Lusuban king Kampo ning Clark) was part of a series of morning airstrikes on United States Pacific island military bases opening Japanese participation in World War II. The attack was intended to minimize interference from the Far East Air Force (FEAF) during the subsequent invasion of the Philippines by the Empire of Japan.

zh.s: 克拉克机场空袭是日本参与第二次世界大战之初，对美国太平洋岛屿军事基地发动的一系列清晨空袭之一。日军希望削弱远东空军的作战能力，减少其对随后入侵菲律宾的干扰。

en.s: The Japanese invasion of Batan Island (Filipino: Paglusob ng mga Hapones sa Isla ng Batan) was the first step in their invasion of the Philippines, an American commonwealth territory. The US had acquired the former Spanish colony half a century earlier, when it defeated Spain in the Spanish-American War. The objective of the invasion was to seize local airstrips that could be used as forward operating bases for fighter aircraft to be utilized in further assaults in the Luzon mainland.

zh.s: 日军入侵巴丹岛是入侵菲律宾的第一步。美国此前已在美西战争中击败西班牙，并在半个世纪前取得这个前西班牙殖民地。日军计划夺取岛上的机场，作为战斗机前进基地，为后续进攻吕宋岛提供支援。

en.s: The Philippines campaign, also known as the Battle of the Philippines (Filipino: Labanan sa Pilipinas) or the Fall of the Philippines, was the invasion of the Philippines by the Empire of Japan during the Pacific War and World War II. The operation to capture the islands, which was defended by the U.S. and Philippine Armies, was intended to prevent interference with Japan's expansion in Southeast Asia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 菲律宾战役又称菲律宾之战或菲律宾沦陷，是太平洋战争和第二次世界大战期间日本帝国对菲律宾发动的入侵。菲律宾由美国和菲律宾军队防守；日军试图攻占群岛，以阻止盟军干扰其在东南亚的扩张。

en.s: During the Japanese occupation of the islands in World War II, there was an extensive Philippine resistance movement (Filipino: Kilusan ng Paglaban sa Pilipinas), which opposed the Japanese and their collaborators with active underground and guerrilla activity that increased over the years. Fighting the guerrillas – apart from the Japanese regular forces – were a Japanese-formed Bureau of Constabulary (later taking the name of the old Philippine Constabulary during the Second Republic), the Kempeitai (the Japanese military police), and the Makapili (Filipinos fighting for the Japanese).

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间日本占领菲律宾群岛，菲律宾各地出现了大规模抵抗运动（菲律宾语：Kilusan ng Paglaban sa Pilipinas）。抵抗者通过地下活动和游击战反抗日本及其合作者，行动规模逐年扩大。除日本正规军外，镇压游击队的还有日本组建的宪兵组织（后来在第二共和国时期沿用旧菲律宾警察部队之名）、日本宪兵队，以及与日军并肩作战的菲律宾人组织马卡皮利。

en.t: On 8 December 1941, Japanese bombers struck American airfields on Luzon
en.s: The Pacific War, sometimes called the Asia–Pacific War or the Pacific Theater, was the theater of World War II fought between Japan and the Allies in East and Southeast Asia, the Pacific and Indian Oceans, and Oceania. It was geographically the largest theater of the war, including the Pacific Ocean theater, the South West Pacific theater, the Second Sino-Japanese War, and the brief Soviet–Japanese War, and included some of the largest naval battles in history.

zh.t: 1941年12月8日，日本轰炸机袭击吕宋岛的美国机场
zh.s: 太平洋战争有时也称亚太战争或太平洋战区，是第二次世界大战在东亚、东南亚、太平洋、印度洋和大洋洲展开的战区，交战双方为日本和盟军。它在地理范围上是二战最大的战区，包括太平洋战场、西南太平洋战场、第二次中日战争以及短暂的苏日战争，也发生过历史上一些规模最大的海战。

en.s: The Battle of Guam was an engagement during the Pacific War in World War II that took place from 8 to 10 December 1941 on Guam in the Mariana Islands between Japan and the United States. The American garrison was defeated by Japanese forces on 10 December, which resulted in an occupation until the Second Battle of Guam in 1944.
en.n: The Battle of Guam was an engagement during the Pacific War in World War II that took place from 8 to 10 December 1941 on Guam in the Mariana Islands between Japan and the United States.

zh.s: 关岛战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战争期间的一场战斗，于1941年12月8日至10日在马里亚纳群岛的关岛爆发，交战双方为日本和美国。日军于12月10日击败美国守军，随后占领关岛，直至1944年美军在第二次关岛战役中重新夺回该岛。

en.s: The Battle of Wareo (27 November – 8 December 1943) was fought by Australian and Japanese forces in New Guinea during the Huon Peninsula campaign of World War II in the later part of 1943. Coming after the capture of Sattelberg by the Allies, the battle took place amidst the Australian advance north towards Sio.

en.s: A referendum on retaining the republic was held in Greece on 8 December 1974. After the collapse of the military junta that ruled the country from 1967, the issue of the form of government remained unsolved. The Junta had already staged a plebiscite held on 29 July 1973, which resulted in the establishment of the Republic. However, after the fall of the military regime, the new government, under Constantine Karamanlis, decided to hold another one, as Junta legal acts were considered illegal. Constantine II, the former King, was banned by the new government from returning to Greece to campaign in the referendum, but the Karamanlis government allowed him to make a televised address to the nation.

zh.s: 希腊于1974年12月8日举行公投，决定是否保留共和制。1967年上台的军政府倒台后，国家政体问题仍未解决。此前，军政府于1973年7月29日举行公投，宣布成立共和国；军政府垮台后，新政府认为其法律行为无效，因此决定再次举行公投。前国王康斯坦丁二世被禁止回国参加竞选，但卡拉曼利斯政府允许他向全国发表电视讲话。

en.s: The 1979 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held on December 8, 1979. Incumbent Governor Edwin Edwards was ineligible to run for a third term, making it the only gubernatorial election in Louisiana between 1972 and 1991 to not feature Edwards as a candidate. In the race to succeed him, Dave Treen narrowly defeated Louis Lambert to become the first Republican governor of Louisiana since the Reconstruction Era.

en.s: John Winston Ono Lennon (born John Winston Lennon; 9 October 1940 – 8 December 1980) was an English musician, songwriter and activist. en.t: The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation, the regional intergovernmental organization and geopolitical union in South Asia, is established
en.s: The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) is an intergovernmental organization comprising eight sovereign states with full membership: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. It also includes nine non-member observers: Australia, China, the European Union, Iran, Japan, Mauritius, Myanmar, South Korea, and the United States. As of 2021, SAARC members collectively account for about 21% of the world's population and 5.21% (US$4.47 trillion) of the global economy.

zh.s: 南亚区域合作联盟于1985年12月8日成立，是由阿富汗、孟加拉国、不丹、印度、马尔代夫、尼泊尔、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡8个主权国家组成的政府间组织，另有澳大利亚、中国、欧盟、伊朗、日本、毛里求斯、缅甸、韩国和美国9个观察员。截至2021年，成员国人口约占全球21%，经济总量约占全球5.21%（约4.47万亿美元）。

en.s: The Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty (INF Treaty) was an arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union (and its successor state, the Russian Federation). US president Ronald Reagan and Soviet General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev signed the treaty on 8 December 1987. The US Senate approved the treaty on 27 May 1988, and Reagan and Gorbachev ratified it on 1 June 1988.

en.t: Erez crossing collision precedes the First Intifada
en.s: On December 8, 1987, an Israeli truck collided with vans carrying Palestinian workers back to the Gaza Strip at the Erez crossing. Palestinian workers were killed and others injured. The collision fueled anger amid wider grievances; protests erupted in the Jabalya refugee camp and around Gaza's Shifa hospital on December 9, the date commonly given for the start of the First Intifada.
en.n: The traffic collision occurred on December 8; the uprising's initial protests are generally dated December 9.

zh.t: 埃雷兹口岸车祸成为第一次巴勒斯坦大起义的导火索
zh.s: 1987年12月8日，一辆以色列卡车在埃雷兹口岸撞上载着巴勒斯坦工人返回加沙地带的车辆，造成工人死伤。这起车祸激起愤怒，也加剧了长期积累的不满。次日，加沙的贾巴利亚难民营和希法医院一带爆发抗议；12月9日通常被视为第一次巴勒斯坦大起义的起点。
zh.n: 车祸发生在12月8日；最初的抗议一般记为12月9日。

en.s: The 1988 Remscheid A-10 crash occurred on December 8, 1988, when a United States Air Force attack jet, an A-10 Thunderbolt II crashed onto a residential area in the city of Remscheid, West Germany. The aircraft crashed into the upper floor of an apartment complex. In addition to the pilot, five people were killed. Fifty others were injured, including many seriously. According to press reports the plane was engaged in a low-altitude flight exercise. It belonged to a unit from Bentwaters Air Base but at the time of the accident was stationed at Nörvenich Air Base.

zh.s: 1988年12月8日，一架美国空军A-10“雷电II”攻击机在西德雷姆沙伊德市坠入居民区。飞机撞进一栋公寓楼的上层。除飞行员外，另有5人遇难；50人受伤，其中多人伤势严重。媒体报道称，飞机当时正在进行低空飞行训练。该机隶属宾特沃特斯空军基地的一个单位，但事故发生时驻扎在诺尔文尼希空军基地。

en.t: As the USSR disintegrated, Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine signed the Belovezha Accords on 8 December 1991, declaring that the Union had effectively ceased to exist and proclaiming the CIS in its place
en.s: The Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) is a regional intergovernmental organisation of states in Eurasia. It was formed following the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991. It covers an area of 20,368,759 km2 (7,864,422 sq mi) and has an estimated population of 246,200,194. en.t: 1997 New Zealand National Party leadership election
en.s: An election for the position of leader of the New Zealand National Party occurred in 1997. Jim Bolger, the incumbent leader and prime minister, ended up losing his position. Transport Minister Jenny Shipley grew increasingly frustrated and disillusioned with the cautious pace of National's leader, Jim Bolger, and with what she saw as the disproportionate influence of coalition partner New Zealand First. She began gathering support to replace Bolger in mid-1997. Shipley struck later that year, while Bolger attended the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting. She convinced a majority of her National Party colleagues to back her bid for the leadership. When Bolger returned to New Zealand, he discovered that Shipley was not only planning to challenge his leadership, but had lined up enough support in the party room to defeat him. Facing an untenable situation, he resigned, and Shipley was unanimously elected to replace him. As leader of the governing party, she became Prime Minister on 8 December 1997.

zh.s: 新西兰国家党于1997年举行领袖选举。时任党魁兼总理吉姆·博尔格最终失去职位。交通部长珍妮·希普利对博尔格谨慎的执政步调，以及联合政府伙伴新西兰优先党影响力过大，越来越不满。她在1997年年中开始争取支持，后来趁博尔格出席英联邦政府首脑会议时发起挑战。希普利说服多数党内同僚支持自己接任。博尔格回国后发现希普利已争取到足够票数，自己无法胜选，遂辞去党魁职务。希普利获一致推举接任，并于1997年12月8日成为总理。

en.s: The Internal Security Department (ISD) is the principal security agency and domestic intelligence service of Singapore. en.s: General elections were held in Gibraltar on 8 December 2011. Two parties, the Gibraltar Social Democrats (GSD) and the Progressive Democrative Party (PDP) and an alliance of the Gibraltar Socialist Labour Party (GSLP) and the Gibraltar Liberals (GLP) each presented a full slate of ten candidates each, making a total of thirty candidates standing for seventeen seats in the Gibraltar Parliament.
